$comment: Pella (windows and doors) is behind bot protection, so plain HTTP, headless Chrome and AvalAI's page fetch all fail with BOT_PROTECTION. The site uses the default engine (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance) with ai_fetch web_search; the shop is never contacted and the values are unverified (AI_UNVERIFIED), so online prices may be out of date. Engines tried on 2026-11-19: http, browser, ai_fetch http and browser: BOT_PROTECTION or ACCESS_DENIED; web_search: success (13 specs, 4 features, 561+579 tokens). Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key.
